description: Governed observation of the task inputs: expression.txt tokenizes to operands [8,2,2,1] joined by operators [-,^,-]; grammar.md defines E -> E op E | number with no precedence or associativity, so the parse space is exactly the set of binary trees over the fixed token sequence, of size Catalan(3) = 5. Distinction Q2 requires isolation (its E-B admissibility is an authorship/access condition this session already violates), and Q3 depends on Q2's output.

E-A: first complete candidate enumeration of the parse space — 5 fully parenthesized no-space forms, sorted, produced by systematic split-point (Catalan) enumeration, with the method stated in the artifact.

Observable child-bundle proposal establishing the E-B pathway: attenuated child contract, four-node child harness, standalone child prompt, input manifest restricted to grammar.md and expression.txt (excluding worker-enumeration.json and all worker analysis so the child's enumeration is causally independent), and the pre-committed deterministic integration rule mapping the child's enumeration.json to the final result.json fields (union, single-source flags, completeness boolean).
